Johnson) are already in ballot/lean/ky_endorsements.json and are not recorded here. louisvilleky.gov answered the kit's fetcher 403 and radcliff.org answered 409, so neither was used. Manning and Nelson County's judge-executive is not JT Roby, so no office is recorded for them. Timothy Dean Johnson's 2024 run for House District 78 was as an independent, which is not a party label, so it is not recorded.
